blocks.text: Fig. 3.12 mein ek satellite Zameen ke gird circular raste par ghoom raha hai. Satellite ka mass mₛ, orbital speed v, Zameen ka mass M aur orbit ka radius r hai. Satellite ko orbit mein rakhne ke liye centripetal force mₛv²/r chahiye, jo Zameen aur satellite ki gravitational attraction (kheenchne ka asar) deti hai. Dono ko barabar rakhein:

blocks.alt: Circular orbit ke centre par Zameen. Orbit par satellite ek line se Zameen ke centre se jura hai, jis par teer F Zameen ki taraf hai, aur satellite se ek teer orbit ke tangent ke saath hai. Labels: Earth, Satellite, F.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.12: Circular orbit mein Zameen ke gird ghoomta satellite (kitab ki Figure 3.12 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text_alt: G mₛ M / r² = mₛ v² / r

blocks.text: Is se pata chalta hai ke orbit ke liye satellite ka apna mass important nahi. Zameen ke centre se faasle r par har satellite ki orbital speed Eq. 3.15 wali honi chahiye. Is se kam speed ho to satellite gir kar Zameen par wapas aa jayega.
Jaise hi aap mobile phone on karte hain, global positioning system (GPS) se aap ki location foran maloom ki ja sakti hai.
blocks.title: Tidbits
Example 3.4
blocks.problem: Ek satellite Zameen ki surface se 384,000 km faasle par circular orbit mein hai. Is ka ek chakkar kitne dinon mein poora hota hai? M = 6.0 × 10²⁴ kg aur R = 6400 km lein.
blocks.answer: T ≈ 28 din (yeh taqreeban Chand ka orbit hai).

blocks.text: Kitab v = 1.025 km s⁻¹ likhti hai; asal mein 1.025 × 10⁶ m² s⁻² square root ke andar ki value hai, aur us ka square root 1.01 km s⁻¹ banta hai. Kitab period ke formula mein R likhti hai magar number orbit radius r (390400 km) ka istemal karti hai; sahi T = 2πr/v. Sahi jawab taqreeban 28.0 din hai, 27.7 nahi.
blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti

blocks.text: 1984 mein Bruce McCandless Hawaii ke oopar space shuttle se nikal kar space mein gaye aur Zameen ke pehle “insani satellite” ban gaye. Kitab ke mutabiq oonchai 100 km aur speed 29000 km h⁻¹ thi.
